board: Pennsylvania State Board of Accountancy (Department of State)

cycle.label: Reporting period
cycle.note: Licenses expire December 31 of odd-numbered years; CPE runs January 1 of the even year to December 31 of the odd year.

requirements.label: Self-study
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. No more than 40 hours from self-study (including nano) and preapproved authorship count. We use each course's delivery format — set it on each course.

requirements.label: Accounting & attest/auditing
requirements.note: 24 hours in accounting and attest/auditing subjects if you participate in attest activity.

newLicensee.note: Licensees who passed the CPA exam during this reporting period are exempt from CPE for their first renewal.

licenseDateHint: Pennsylvania licenses expire December 31 of odd-numbered years (e.g. 12/31/2027).
issueDateHint: Enter the date you passed the CPA exam — if it's in this reporting period, no CPE is due for your first renewal.
limitsNotTracked: Instruction: max 40 hours (3 CPE per 50 minutes presented).
Authorship: 20 per publication, 40 total (shares the 40-hour self-study cap).
